name: dimu-ntuple-rl-v1

steps.cmd: (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq proot > /dev/null 2>&1); command -v proot || echo 'proot not installed by apt (delphi_rootless.sh will try the release binary)'
cd /work && sed -i 's/\r$//' fetch.sh inner_ntuple.sh && bash -n fetch.sh && bash -n inner_ntuple.sh && bash fetch.sh > /out/fetch.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/fetch.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && python -m py_compile ocipull.py validate.py test_validate.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; for f in delphi_rootless.sh delphi_env.sh run_ntuple.sh inner_ntuple.sh; do bash -n $f >> /out/compile.txt 2>&1 || rc=1; done; echo "syntax rc=$rc" >> /out/compile.txt; cat /out/compile.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && bash delphi_rootless.sh /work/inner_ntuple.sh > /out/rootless.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; head -c 5000 /out/rootless.txt; echo; echo '[...]'; tail -c 16000 /out/rootless.txt; grep -E '^(OCIPULL|ROOTLESS|DELPHIENV|METHOD|NTUPLE_RL|NTUPLE_RL_RUN):|inner rc=|FATAL' /out/rootless.txt; echo '--- VALIDATION_JSON'; cat /out/ntuple/validation_val.json 2>/dev/null | head -c 20000; echo; echo '--- runs.txt
